item.title: Honetsuki-dori: Marugame's Grilled Chicken Leg — Guide
item.description: Honetsuki-dori is the signature local dish of Marugame in western Kagawa: a whole bone-in chicken leg (thigh and drumstick) marinated and roasted whole with plenty of garlic and black pepper until the skin is crisp and browned and the meat inside is juicy and savoury. It comes in two versions — ‘oyadori’, an older, firmer and more intensely flavoured bird that you chew and savour, and ‘wakadori’, a younger, more tender chicken.
